summary.name: Rectangle
summary.one_liner: Rectangle is a free, open-source macOS app for moving and resizing windows with keyboard shortcuts or by dragging windows to snap areas.
use_cases: Snapping windows to halves, corners or thirds on macOS
Resizing and moving windows without a mouse
summary.what_it_does: Rectangle lets you move and resize macOS windows using keyboard shortcuts or by dragging windows to screen edges and corners to snap them into place. Repeating a shortcut cycles a window through different sizes. It supports portrait display layouts. The page describes it as nearly a complete drop-in replacement for Spectacle, and Spectacle's default shortcuts can be selected on first run. The page also promotes a paid Rectangle Pro version with custom shortcuts for any size and position, offered free for 10 days.
notable: Free and open source, requires macOS 14+
Can adopt Spectacle's default shortcuts on first run; nearly a drop-in replacement for Spectacle
Repeating a shortcut cycles window sizes
Paid Rectangle Pro adds custom shortcuts for any size and position
caveats: Rectangle Pro is a paid upgrade with a 10-day free trial
